en.name: CodeDeal
en.short_description: Promo codes to browse, search, copy and share
en.subtitle: Promo codes that work
en.description:
CodeDeal collects discount codes and gets out of the way.

FIND ONE
Browse by category or search — including by voice — and filter to what you are actually shopping for. Every deal shows what it takes off and, where there is one, the code.

USE IT
One tap copies the code, another opens the store. Share a deal with whoever needs it.

YOURS
Browsing needs no account. Signing in is optional.

ADS
CodeDeal is free and shows ads from Google AdMob: a banner on the browsing screens and, now and then, a full-screen ad when you switch between them. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. Where the law requires consent (the EEA, the UK and Switzerland) you are asked before any ad is requested, and you can change your choice later under Profile > Settings > Privacy choices.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
CodeDeal collects discount codes and gets out of the way.

Intended audience:
Promo codes that work

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
Browsing needs no account. Every browsing feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

Signing in is optional and happens entirely inside the app: Profile tab -> Sign in (or Create account) opens a native email and password form. No web browser or Safari view is opened at any point.

Demo account: qa@americangroup.ai (the password is supplied in the App Review Information sign-in fields).

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Supabase — account sign-in, sign-up and deletion
- Google AdMob (ads)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 19 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, fa, id, pl, sw, th, tr, vi), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Signed in, open the Profile tab and tap Delete account. After a confirmation dialog the account is permanently deleted and the app signs out. No email or website is involved.
